item.tib: klu 'dul drag po khyung gis bsgrubs pa
item.coloph: drag po khyung gi bsgrub (sgrub) pa zhes bya ba/ kun bzang thugs kyis (kyi) dgongs pa/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis/ man ngag kun gyi bcud phyung ste/ don che tshag chung man ngag 'di/ thugs la shin tu gab pa ste/ phyi rab (rabs) 'gro ba'i don ched tu (du/)dus mtha'i rnam 'byor bdag la gnang / shin tu zab bo sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ drag po khyung gi sgrab pa 'di/ dad ldan grogs pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs bstan srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog/
